lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sm3Au9Bi3 (reduced formula SmAu3Bi) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 194), with 15 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and Sm centers each with 12 Au neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while each Au center has 9 geometric neighbors (3 Au, 3 Bi, 3 Sm). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that 9-vertex Au polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces with one another and with 12-vertex Bi and Sm polyhedra.
